en.explicacion: Mark combines the prophecies of Malachi 3:1 and Isaiah 40:3 to present the mission of John the Baptist as the precursor sent to prepare the way of the Lord.

es.explicacion: San Pablo retoma la enseñanza de Jesús sobre no juzgar al prójimo, explicando que quien juzga con soberbia se condena a sí mismo por hacer las mismas cosas.

en.explicacion: Saint Paul takes up Jesus' teaching on not judging one's neighbor, explaining that whoever judges with pride condemns themselves by doing the same things.
